items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: And Marty was slippers were sliding.

ctx.x: But they had the drum up there too. Do you remember that?

Well, I remember about the drum being up there. I remember that. But I remember having one of the greatest funerals. It was seven blocks long and the greatest second line. You know, he'd come out from Cadillus Street, you know. And Marty was slippers were sliding. It was a horrible thing. Yeah, they made a picture. They just like they made a picture of my brother's funeral when it was coming out. They took the picture of us when he was coming out the house and right at this church here, Catholic Church Tulane.…
Well, first we'd like to get your name down here. All right.
